relationships.subject: ELF1
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistically, more ELF1 directly bond to and activated Mmp9 promoter in injured DRG neurons after CCI.

relationships.subject: ELF1
relationships.evidence_quote: Mimicking this increase through DRG microinjection of AAV5 expressing full-length Elf1 upregulated DRG MMP9 and produced enhanced responses to mechanical, heat, and cold stimuli in naive mice.

relationships.subject: MMP9
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP9, an endoprotease, participates in nerve trauma-induced nociceptive hypersensitivity through interleukin-1β cleavage in injured DRG

key_findings: Nerve injury increases ELF1 in injured DRG neurons, which transcriptionally activates Mmp9.
Knockdown of DRG ELF1 attenuates induction and maintenance of CCI-induced hypersensitivity and dorsal horn central sensitization.
